copy.description: Looking for a simple summer nap spot for your pet? This summer sleeping mat gives your cat or dog a spot of their own. It is a sleeping pad made of cloth, which the maker lists as waterproof, so wet paws and small spills are easier to clean up. It is made for both cats and dogs, which makes it a practical pick for a home with more than one kind of pet. Set it on the floor, a bed, or in a crate where your pet already likes to lie, and see whether they settle in. It is a simple, no-fuss addition to the spots you already use. This page does not list exact dimensions or a cooling temperature, so measure your space before you order.

faq.a: It is sold in size XS in four colors (blue, coffee, grey, pink). The maker does not list exact dimensions.
